tmtv — SSH terminal sharing, built on modern tmux.

tmtv lets you share your terminal session instantly over SSH. Your pair
runs one command and lands in your session. No plugins, no accounts, no
browser required. It also offers an optional web viewer for read-only
access from a browser.

tmtv is a fork of tmate, rebased on tmux 3.6a, bringing nine years of
tmux improvements that tmate never had: popup menus, extended keys, sixel
graphics, and more.

Current version: 1.2.5
License: ISC (same as tmux)
Author: Lars-Erik Jonsson (SA3LEJ)
Repository: https://github.com/sa3lej/tmtv
Website: https://tmtv.se
Releases: https://github.com/sa3lej/tmtv/releases
Homebrew: brew install sa3lej/tap/tmtv


INSTALL

  curl -fsSL https://tmtv.se/install.sh | sh

Supported platforms: Linux (amd64, arm64, arm32v7, arm32v6, i386) and
macOS (arm64, amd64). Linux binaries are fully static (musl, zero
external dependencies). You can also build from source.


USAGE

  1. Run "tmtv" to start a shared session.
  2. tmtv prints two SSH tokens:
     - A read-write token for pair programming (full terminal access).
     - A read-only token for observers (view only, no input).
  3. Your pair connects with: ssh TOKEN@tmtv.se
  4. A web viewer link is also provided for browser-based read-only
     viewing at https://tmtv.se/TOKEN (no install needed for viewers).

Named sessions:

  tmtv new-session -s myproject
  tmtv attach -t myproject

Detach with the standard tmux prefix (Ctrl-B, then D). Reattach by
running "tmtv" again — it auto-attaches to your detached session.


KEY FEATURES

- SSH terminal sharing with read-write and read-only access tokens
- Built on tmux 3.6a — full modern tmux feature set
- Named sessions for persistent, recognizable session names
- Web viewer powered by xterm.js (SSE streaming, 256-color, RGB,
  Unicode, multi-pane layout, themes)
- Viewer counting in the status bar (SSH and web viewers separately)
- Static Linux binaries with zero dependencies
- One-line install via curl
- Homebrew tap for macOS
- Self-hostable server (tmtv-server)
- ISC license (permissive, same as tmux)


COMPARISON

vs tmate: tmate is stuck on tmux 2.4 (2017) and no longer maintained.
tmtv is rebased on tmux 3.6a with all modern features.

vs VS Code Live Share: tmtv is terminal-native. No IDE required. Works
with any editor, any workflow, any shell.

vs Tuple/screen sharing: tmtv shares the terminal session itself, not
pixels. Low bandwidth, low latency, works over SSH.


BUILD FROM SOURCE

Linux (Debian/Ubuntu):
  sudo apt-get install build-essential autoconf automake pkg-config \
    libevent-dev libncurses-dev libssh-dev libmsgpack-dev libbsd-dev \
    bison libutf8proc-dev
  sh autogen.sh && ./configure && make

macOS:
  brew install autoconf automake pkg-config libevent libssh msgpack-c \
    bison utf8proc
  sh autogen.sh && ./configure --enable-utf8proc && make


SELF-HOSTING

tmtv-server is the relay component. Build it alongside the client from
the same source tree. The server handles SSH relay, authentication, SSE
streaming for the web viewer, and session management. See the repository
for deployment details and the Caddyfile for reverse proxy configuration.
